Dear Rami,

Yes, we can arrange the booking on a monthly basis and provide you with the same rate mentioned above. However, please note that monthly extensions are subject to availability, as the apartment will also remain open on online platforms, and we may receive other bookings during this period.

If you would like to guarantee the apartment for the full 3 months, we can block it for you in advance with the agreed rate. In this case, we would require payment for the first month, the security deposit, and at least a partial payment for the last month to secure the reservation.

Without any payment, we are unable to block the apartment exclusively for 3 months. If you prefer to proceed on a monthly basis, we will be happy to assist with each extension, and we will do our best to maintain the same rate; however, the extension will always be subject to availability.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your kind understanding.
